response.sql: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex), 0) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex ORDER BY sex;
